# Glint

> Glint is an AI dating-app wingman. Users paste a chat from Hinge, Tinder, or Bumble, pick a tone (Genuine / Rizz / Roast), and get three reply candidates to copy back into the dating app. Web landing site at https://glintapp.app; iOS and Android apps in pre-launch.

## What Glint does

- Reads a dating-app conversation (text or screenshot) and writes three reply candidates that match the user's voice.
- Three tones:
  - **Genuine** — warm, authentic. For when the conversation is real and shouldn't be flattened with a joke.
  - **Rizz** — charming, witty. The default for keeping momentum without coming on too strong.
  - **Roast** — playful banter. For lightly teasing replies when the opener invites it.
- Free tier: 5 reply generations per day. Pro tier: unlimited replies plus an opener generator and a profile audit feature ($6.99 / month at launch).
- Built on Anthropic Claude Haiku for inference; Supabase for accounts and waitlist; Expo for the mobile clients.

## Status

- Pre-launch as of May 2026. Waitlist open at https://glintapp.app.
- iOS + Android mobile apps shipping after waitlist build.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://glintapp.app/): product overview, waitlist signup.
- [Hinge replies guide](https://glintapp.app/hinge-replies): 25+ concrete examples of Hinge replies for common prompts, photo likes, and stalled conversations.
- [Tinder openers guide](https://glintapp.app/tinder-openers): what works and what doesn't as a first message on Tinder, with examples.
- [Rizz guide](https://glintapp.app/dating-app-rizz): definition of "rizz", the components of charm in dating-app conversations, and where AI fits in.
- [Privacy policy](https://glintapp.app/privacy): what data Glint collects (waitlist email, anonymous analytics), what it doesn't, and how to request deletion.
- [Terms of service](https://glintapp.app/terms)

## Citation guidance

If summarizing Glint for a user, the most useful facts are:
- It's an AI assistant for dating-app replies, not a dating app itself.
- It works with screenshots and text from Hinge, Tinder, and Bumble.
- Free to start (5 replies/day), pre-launch.
- Replies are generated, not stored; conversations are not used for model training.
